about: Structured eligibility for the entries that serve the four questions (architecture 4.3). Every rule is based on a verbatim quote from the same record's eligibility or notes text, listed in basis. A rule the source does not state is left out; a blocker the source is silent on is "unknown". Drafted by Claude from the seed; every entry stays "draft" until a person reviews it.
